normalization.model_selection: four spatial block groups, simplest within one standard error of lowest validation error
normalization.outside_domain: invalid / NaN; never clamp or interpret

normalization.noise_sample_policy: independently recorded substrate support, not all geometrically valid pixels

clipping.policy: No shape or color geometry veto; domain clipping only, every surviving connected component retained.
